patch.value: Adopt typed SDK define builders for every registration

Route every extension registration through the SDK authoring builders (defineCommand, defineImporter, defineExporter, defineItemField) as locally declared, fully typed identity stand-ins, so each registration literal is contract-checked at the authoring site instead of at activation. Keeps the package type-only against pm-cli, adding no runtime module edge to the published bundle.

Every registerCommand/registerImporter/registerExporter/registerItemFields call site wrapped in its typed builder; no any-typed ctx parameters remain on those handlers; zero runtime imports from pm-cli; typecheck and full test suite green; import and export verified functionally against real Beads JSONL.
Registrations contract-checked at edit time; runtime behaviour unchanged.

84/84 tests green. Functionally verified against real Beads JSONL in a throwaway workspace: import of 3 beads linked 2 dependency edges from both the dependencies[kind=blocked_by] and blocked_by[] forms; export round-tripped all 3 preserving original bead ids as depends_on_id. Both documented output paths (--output FILE and --quiet to stdout) emit strictly valid JSONL.

value.author: claude-orchestrator
value.text: The define* builders are zero-cost identity functions, so wrapping registrations changes no runtime behaviour — but it does replace the any-typed ctx parameters on importer/exporter handlers with the real ImportExportContext, which is where the type checking actually lands.

patch.value: All registrations routed through typed SDK builders; import/export verified functionally against real Beads JSONL.
